ྈ'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi phrin las bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ 'chi med dbang gi tshe sgrub kyi phrin las bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bzhugs:
ྈྈྈ bcom ldan tshe dpag med pa dang: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

bkra shis yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bkra shis pa'i sa la maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi byas te pho brang spyi mthun bris pa'i lha gnas pad+ma 'dab brgyad mdzes tshon bya: dbus su rta mgrin dbang gi sku mngon rtogs dang mthun pa'am: yang na hrīḥdamar po bri: rin po che'i bum pa chag gas med pa'i nang du rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang ba dmar gyi 'o ma: bum rdzas nyer lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga rnams kyis sum gnyis bkang: mgul chings dar le brgan gyis bya: 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan: gzungs thag ser po'am sna lnga btags la dal gyi dbus su bkod: gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba dang: tshe 'brang dmar po: tshe ril tshe chang dang bcas pa bkod: phyi nang gsang mchod kyis legs par bskor: tshe 'gugs pa'i rten du mda' ma nyams pa la dar sna lnga dang: gser dngul g.yu gsum gyis brgyan pa bsham: sgrub pa po stan bde ba la 'dug nas sgrub pa'i bya ba la 'jug go: sa ma ya: cho ga dngos la sbyor dngos rjes gsum mo: sbyor ba la dang po skyabs 'gro ni:
na mo: bdag gzhan dus 'di nas bzung ste: byang chub snying po ma 'thob bar: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi:
gnyis pa sems bskyed ni:
na mo: 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs bar: sems can don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir: 'chi med tshe la dbang ba yi: rig 'dzin go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi:
gsum pa tshogs gsog ni:

na mo: bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus 'khor bcas la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang mchod bdag lus longs spyod 'bul: sdig sgrib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus bshags: bsod nams dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: 'gro rnams sgrol phyir chos 'khor bskor du gsol: mgon po mya ngan mi 'da' gzhan don bzhugs: dus gsum dge ba'i rtsa ba gang lags pa: 'gro rnams bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo:
bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni:

oṃ: stong gsum 'jig rten bkod pa'i zhing khams su: lha mi'i longs spyod 'dod yon phung por spung: ā: rang bzhin dag pa longs sku'i pho brang du: 'dod yon lha mo zhing gi rdul snyed gtibs: hūm̐: dgongs klong mnyam nyid chos sku gdal ba'i ngang: snang srid thams cad kun bzang rgyan du shar: hrī: phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇ+ḍal rgya chen po: skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: bzhes nas bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang: tshe bsod longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza ho:
lnga pa bgegs bsal ba ni:

hūm̐: nga ni 'bar ba dbang gi sku: thugs las khro tshogs phyogs bcur 'gyed: bka' gsang sgrub la bar gcod bgegs: thams cad bskrad cing gzir bar bya: hūm̐ hūm̐: lha dang lha min gdug pa can: bka' las ma 'da' gzhan du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: mtshon cha 'bar ba sna tshogs kyis: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐: oṃ suṃ bha ni
sogs drag sngags brjod: thun gyis brab par bya'o: drug pa mtshams gcod ni:
hūm̐: stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten kun: mtshon cha sna lnga'i gur khang 'khrigs: khro tshogs mang pos phyogs mtshams gang: bgegs rnams 'da' ba'i gnas med do: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐:
bdun pa byin 'beb ni:

hūm̐: bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog dpal: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas: rang bzhin dbyings nas sku skyod la: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byin chen phob: rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bzhi skur: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya ā be sha ya ho:
brgyad pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni:

hrī: snang srid snod bcud dngos po kun: kun bzang mchod pa'i phyag rgya che: sman gtor rak+ta dam tshig rdzas: ye shes bdud rtsir rnam par dag: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā:
dngos gzhi las dang po lha bsgom pa ni:

hrī: rang byung ye shes lnga yi dngos: stong gsum 'jig rten rnam par dag: rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing khams su: ye shes lnga ldan gzhal med khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs ldan: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: phyi nang mnyam yangs 'od 'bar dbus: 'chi bdag nyi zla pad+ma'i steng: hrīḥlas bdag nyid gar gyi dbang: rta mgrin pad+ma he ru ka: dmar gsal zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo rab tu khros: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dgu rngam: ral pa kham nag 'bar ba'i dbus: rta mgo ljang gu rab tu 'jigs: rol pa'i rta skad phyogs bcur sgrog: pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ dbyug to g.yas: bhan+dha lcags sgrog mdung thung g.yon: zhabs bzhi gar gyis gdan la rol: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad gsol: gar gyi nyams dgu dag dang ldan: yum mchog rdo rje phag mo dmar: g.yas pas gri gug yab la 'khyud: g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob: dbu gtsug phag zhal nag po ngur: sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bde bar rol: ye shes me 'bar klong na gsal: yab kyi thugs kar 'od lnga'i klong: bcom ldan tshe dpag yab yum dang: tshe bdag rigs bzhi yum dang bcas: lha mo bzhi dang mgyogs ma bzhi: sgo ma bzhi bcas yongs rdzogs gsal:
gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni:

hrī: 'og min gnas su kun bzang tshe dpag med: bde chen zhing na mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsol: thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul khro bo'i sku: gar gyi dbang phyug rta mgrin dbang gi lha: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas pa yang: 'gro ba'i don phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza:
gsum pa bzhugs gsol ni:

hrī: gdod nas 'gyur med bde chen dag pa'i lha: 'gro 'ong gnyis med rang snang lhun grub sku: 'khrul pa'i dbang gis tha dad so sor bzung: deng nas gnyis med ngang du brtan par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:
bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ni:

hrī: rgyal ba kun gyi dbang phyug bcom ldan dpal: dbang chen yab yum 'chi med tshe yi lha: 'khor dang bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: tshe dbang dngos grub deng 'dir bdag la stsol: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho:
lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: dag byed gtsang ma'i zhabs bsil kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: yid 'ong mdzes ldan me tog kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: dri zhim sbyar ba'i bdug spos kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dhū pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: rin chen snang gsal sgron me kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ā lo ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: dri ldan bsil ba'i chab rgyun kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī:

stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: ro bcud nus ldan zhal zas kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra nai wid+yā pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: yid 'phrog sgra snyan rol mo kun: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: sna tshogs gzugs kyi bye brag rnams: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rū pa pra tits+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: sna tshogs sgra yi bye brag rnams: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: sna tshogs dri yi bye brag rnams: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra gan+dhe pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi: sna tshogs ro yi bye brag rnams: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ra sa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: stong gsum rab 'byams 'jig rten gyi:

sna tshogs reg bya'i bye brag rnams: 'chi med tshe yi lha la 'bul: 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes su gsol: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra spar+she pra tīts+tsha swā hā: hrī: dug lnga rang grol ye shes lnga dang ldan: rigs lnga yab yum sbyor ba'i bdud rtsi 'di: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bdag la stsol: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛta khā hi: hrī: rgyud drug 'khor ba bsgral pa'i dmar chen po: bdag 'dzin tshar gcod khams gsum dbang sdud phyir: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la mchod pa 'bul: dbang dang drag po'i las rnams myur 'grub mdzod: oṃ ma hā rak+ta khā hi: hrī: dam rdzas rmad byung rgyan gyi gtor chen po: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro: 'dod yon lnga yi lha mo dpag med bcas: 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: oṃ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi:
drug pa bstod pa ni:

hrī: bde chen dbang gi dkyil 'khor du: gar gyi dbang phyug lha yi lha: thugs rje chen po khros pa'i dpal: rta mgrin dbang gi sku la bstod: skye ba med las skye ba'i tshul: bde stong klong yangs don gyi yum: dbang gi thugs dam bskang mdzad ma: rdo rje phag mo'i sku la bstod: rgyal ba rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dpal: 'chi med mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das: bde chen mgon po 'od mi 'gyur: tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang ba bde chen gos dkar mo: tshe bdag rigs bzhi so so'i yum: tshe yi lha mo mgyogs ma bzhi: sgo ma bzhi dang bcas la bstod:
bdun pa bzlas pa ni:

tshe dpag med kyi thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du hrīḥdamar po sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rgyal ba thams cad mchod cing thugs rgyud bskul: sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sbyang: kun kyang mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i go 'phang la bkod: 'khor 'das kyi tshe yi dwangs bcud dngos grub ma lus pa bsdus nas thugs kar thim pas dbang dang dngos grub thob par
bsgom la:
oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa gu ru ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐ hrī: a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+tī ye swā hā:
mang du bzla: gzungs thag la bzung ste:
bum nang tshe yi lha tshogs rang 'dra ba mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i sku las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab: gzungs thag la brgyud de rang gi snying gar thim pas tshe dbang dngos grub thob par
bsgom la bzlas pa bya: brgyad pa tshe 'gugs ni: mda' dar g.yab la:

hrī: 'khor 'das dbang bsgyur tshe yi bdag: rta mgrin dbang gis tshe khug cig: skye 'gag 'gyur med don gyi yum: rdo rje phag mos tshe khug cig: 'chi med mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das: tshe dpag med pas tshe khug cig: bde chen gos dkar gsang ba'i yum: mkha' dbyings klong nas tshe khug cig: tshe bdag rigs bzhi yab dang yum: gnyis med bde ba'i tshe khug cig: shar gyi tshe bdag lā s+ye dkar: rdo rje sgeg mos tshe khug cig: lho yi tshe bdag ma l+ye sngo: rin chen dpal phreng tshe khug cig: nub kyi tshe bdag gīrti dmar: pad+ma dbyangs mkhan tshe khug cig: byang gi tshe bdag nīrti ljang: las kyi gar mkhan tshe khug cig: rdo rje dkar mo myur mgyogs mas: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe khug cig: rdo rje ser mo dpal dang ldan: lho yi phyogs nas tshe khug cig: rdo rje dmar mo rdzu 'phrul bdag: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe khug cig: rdo rje ljang mo drag rtsal can: byang gi phyogs nas tshe khug cig: snying rje'i lcags kyus khams gsum 'gugs: shar gyi sgo mas tshe khug cig: byams pa'i zhags pas 'jig rten 'dren: lho yi sgo mas tshe khug cig: dga' ba'i lcags sgrog nyon mongs bsdam: nub kyi sgo mas tshe khug cig: btang snyoms dril bus 'khor ba 'joms: byang gi sgo mas tshe khug cig: lha tshogs ma lus dus la bab: sku yi sprul pas 'jig rten khyab:

'byung ba lnga yi tshe bcud sdus: phung po lnga yi nus pa skyed: ye shes lnga ru bdag grub mdzod: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa gu ru ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐: ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ dza:
rjes kyi rim pa las dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni:

hrī: bdag nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum 'phros: tshogs rdzas ma dag bsregs gtor bkrus: oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūm̐ mthing gis: 'dod yon zag med bdud rtsi'i gter: rab 'byams nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐:
gnyis pa spyan 'dren ni:

hrī: bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas: bcom ldan gar dbang rta mgrin dpal: rdo rje phag mo yum dang bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'og min bde chen zhing mchog nas: 'chi med mgon po tshe dpag med: yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang rgyal ba'i zhing kun nas: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: chos skyong dam can pho mo kun: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza:
gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni:
hrī: rtsa gsum rgyal ba sras 'khor bcas: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho:
bzhi pa bshags pa ni:
ho: bdag gzhan nyon mongs dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las: nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis kun: tshogs kyi mchod pas skong zhing bshags: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a:
lnga pa bsgral ba ni:

hūm̐: bdag 'dzin dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: thugs rje khros pa'i shugs kyis sgrol: sha khrag bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: sarba shā trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: ha la pū dza khā hi:
drug pa lhag ma ni:

bh+yo: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ni: mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs: ging dang laṅka dur khrod bdag: dbang phyug 'bar ma yang 'khor rnams: 'dir gshegs bka' yi lhag gtor bzhes: bstan srung phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma dhā ki nī sa ma ya ba liṃ ta khā hi:
bdun pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams thugs dam bskul zhing dngos grub blang ba ni:

hūm̐: mi gnas chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas: 'gro 'dul thugs rje thabs dang ldan pa'i sku: dus gsum bde gshegs dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i lha: thugs dam rgyud bskul dngos grub char ltar phob: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub mchog: bum pa bzang dang 'dod 'byung nor bu'i tshul: ma lus 'gro ba'i re ba yongs bskang phyir: dus las mi 'da' da lta 'dir stsol cig: badz+ra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā:
sgrub rdzas rnams spyi bor blangs shing: bdud rtsi sogs la rol: dngos grub yid bzhin du thob pa'i mos pa bya'o: brgyad pa bsdu ldang ni:
hrī: chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang: lha dang gzhal yas gnyis med thim: slar yang skye ba'i cho 'phrul che: lha sngags phyag rgya'i rol par bzhengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ:
dgu pa bsngo smon ni:
hrī: bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs: ma lus blo yis gcig bsdus te: byang chub mchog gi rgyu ru bsngo: kun kyang rdzogs sangs rgyas thob shog:
bcu pa bkra shis brjod pa ni:

hrī: bcom ldan pad+ma dbang gi lha: dngos grub mchog stsol bkra shis shog: tshe dang ye shes kun gyi bdag: tshe dpag med kyi bkra shis shog: de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gtso: tshe bdag yab yum bkra shis shog: gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad pa'i bdag: 'khor tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod bgyis pa'i mthus: don gnyis lhun grub bkra shis shog:

ces rol mo'i sgra sgrog par bya'o: slob dpon pad+ma dang jo mo mkhar chen bza'i thugs dam gyi zab chos 'di da lta rin chen gter du sbas: phyi rabs skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: :
1$0000250༁ཻཾ: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgrub thabs rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so: :1$0000300ྈྈྈ gar dbang 'chi med lha la phyag 'tshal lo:
dang po phyi sgrub ni: rang bde ba'i gdan la 'dug nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang tshogs gsag maṇ+ḍal rnams byas la:
oṃ swa bhā wa
sogs brjod pas/

chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems yi ge hrīḥdamar po 'od dang bcas pa bsgom: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐: zhes brjod pas de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: dbu skra dang sma ra smin ma thams cad me ltar 'bar ba: g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa lcang lo can khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa: ral pa'i gseb nas rta mgo ljang gu'i rta skad drag po phyogs bcur sgrog pa: sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang rus pa dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor thabs su bzhengs pa: sku las ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba bsgom: de'i gnas gsum du yig 'bru gsum dang thugs srog hrīḥdamar po sngags kyis bskor ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par gyur: oṃ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐ phaṭa:
cung zad bzla:

rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po longs sku'i rgyan dang cha lugs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na tshe bum bsnams pa snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur bsgom: de'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang thugs srog hrīḥdamar po sngags phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od zer gyis rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnyis su med par gyur: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ
sogs/

shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā: bla ma mgon po tshe dpag med kyis bdag la dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub dam pa da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol: de ltar mchod cing gsol ba btab pas tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng dang sku'i cha thams cad nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung: rang la thim pas dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob par
bsam la:
oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+tī ye swā hā:
'bum phrag bdun bzlas pas tshe yi bar chad zhi zhing dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro: mthar:
bla ma tshe dpag med rang la thim pas gnyis su med par
bsgom: gnyis pa nang sgrub ni: lha rnams phrin las bdud rtsi'i bum bzang ltar bsgoms la bzlas pa sogs bya: bzlas dmigs kyi khyad par 'di yang bya:

gtso bo yab yum rnams kyi mkha' gsang nas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi bab: 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sku las bdud rtsi 'o ma lta bu byung bas rang lus 'khor lo lnga yi gnas thams cad bdud rtsis gang: bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun gyi dwangs bcud thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags phye blang ba bzhin rang dbang med par bkug nas rang gi snying gar thim pas 'chi med rdo rje'i srog thob par
bsam la:
oṃ h+ya gṝ ba gu ru ā yu sid+dhi ma hā su kha sa ma ya ma ma ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐ nṛ dza: sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:
'bum phrag lnga bzlas pas bde stong tshe yi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro: gsum pa gsang sgrub ni:

1$0000250ri rtser phyin la snga dro'i dus su shar gyi nam mkha' la bltas te drang por 'khod: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: rang tshe dpag yab yum mngon rtogs ltar bsgom: dam ye dbyer med kyi nga rgyal bzung: sbyor mtshams nas 'od zer nam mkha' gang ba 'phros: shar phyogs mthong tshad kyi nam mkha' sogs 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa'i nam mkha' thams cad 'od zer dkar po ston ka'i sprin gyi rnam pa lta bu 'ub 'ub tshur bsdus te rang gi zhal du zhugs: snying gar thim pas nam mkha'i rdo rje tshe thob par bsam la: dmigs pa rtse gcig tu bsgom: sngags ni: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐: 1$0000250zhes yi ge 'bru lnga kho na bzla: skabs su phyogs bcu'i zhing thams cad nas rta mgrin yab yum gyi sku gcig tu ma nges pa kha ba bu yug bzhin du byon nas rang la sib sib thim par bsgom la: rig pa gzengs bstod de ngag tu 1$0000300hūm̐ 1$0000250ring bzla: de ltar nyin re bzhin du nyi shar nas nyi ma phyed la thug gi bar du brtson pas zla ba gcig gis tshe ring ba'i dngos grub dam pa thob par gdon mi za'o: rjes su lha snang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o: 1$0000300

slob dpon pad+mas phyi rabs rnams kyi don du man ngag mdor bsdus te gab pa mngon du phyungs pa'o: phyi rabs dus kyi tha ma la: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rgya rgya rgya:
1$0000250ྈ :lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs rab gsal me long bzhugs so: :1$0000300ྈྈྈ 'chi med dbang gi lha la phyag 'tshal lo:
lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs ni: bdag rta mgrin yab yum du bsgoms la:

yab kyi thugs ka chos kyi 'khor lo rang bzhin 'od lnga 'bar ba'i klong du rma bya nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa: phyag g.yas tshe yi mda' dar dang gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin cing g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng du tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa: sku la dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis rab tu brgyan pa: snang la rang bzhin med pa'i pang du tshe yi yum mchog gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked la 'khril ba: phyag g.yas tshe yi mda' dar dmar po dang: g.yon pad+ma rā ga'i tshe bum bsnams pa: sku la dar dang rin po che dang me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa: zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa: yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o: de rgyab rtsa 'dab bzhi la: shar du mi bskyod tshe dpag med sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa: lho ru rin 'byung tshe dpag med sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa: nub tu rnam par snang mdzad tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa: byang du don grub tshe dpag med sku mdog ljang gu phyag g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon tshe bum bsnams pa:

de dag kyang yum spyan ma dang: mā ma kī dang: gtso mo dbyings phyug dang: sgrol ma rnams sku mdog rang rang gi yab dang mtshungs pa: chags pa'i tshul gyis dgyes par 'khril ba'o: yab rnams kyang rnam 'gyur dang rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso bo dang mthun pa: yum rnams rgyan phyag mtshan gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o: so so'i gdan gyi khyad par shar du seng ge: lhor rta mchog: nub tu glang chen: byang du mkha' lding: nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i steng na rang bzhin 'od lnga 'bar ba'i klong du bzhugs pa'o: de rgyab rtsa 'dab brgyad la: shar du la s+ye dkar mo: lho ru ma l+ye sngon mo: nub tu gīrti dmar mo: byang du nīrti ljang mo: shar lhor dkar mo mgyogs ma: lho nub tu ser mo mgyogs ma: nub byang du dmar mo mgyogs ma: byang shar du ljang mo mgyogs ma: de dag kun kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs pad+ma'i skyil krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa: mdzes 'dzum zhi zhing chags pa'i nyams can: sku la dar dang rin po che du mas brgyan pa: g.yas thams cad mda' dar dmar po g.yob pas tshe bcud 'gugs pa: g.yon rnams tshe bum bsnams nas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba'o: de rgyab phyogs bzhi'i rtsa 'dab la shar du sgo ma lcags kyu ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas lcags kyu bsnams pa: lhor sgo ma zhags pa ma sku mdog ser mo phyag g.yas zhags pa bsnams pa:

nub tu sgo ma lcags sgrog ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas lcags sgrog bsnams pa: byang du sgo ma dril bu ma sku mdog ljang mo phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams pa: kun kyang g.yon tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa: lha mo'i gzugs 'chang zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan cha can: pad zla'i gdan la brkyang bskum gar thabs su bzhengs pa'o: gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po: mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: 'og min rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par

bsam mo: lha yi mngon rtogs rab tu gsal ba 'di yang bdag 'dra slob dpon pad+mas phyi rabs las can gyi don du bkod pa'o: ma 'ongs skal ldan rnams dang 'di 'phrad shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya:
1$0000250ྈ :tshe dbang zab mo rin chen gter bum bzhugs so: :1$0000300ྈྈྈ tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo:
dbang gi rim pa ni: gsol ba 'debs pa 'di ltar bya:
ho: 'chi med mchog stsol lha yi lha: rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin gyis: bdag la 'chi med dbang mchog stsol: bka' bzhin rjes su bsgrub par bgyi:
lan ni:
ho: yang gsang tshe yi dkyil 'khor du: dngos grub rnam gnyis 'thob bya'i phyir: dbang mchog dam pa bdag gis sbyin: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig rgyun du zungs:

de nas skyabs 'gro la sogs bya: dam tshig spyi ltar bzung: slob ma skad cig gis rta mgrin yab yum du bsgom: de yi thugs kar tshe yi lha tshogs bsgom: phyogs bcu'i zhing nas tshe bcud thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas slob ma lhar gsal ba la thim pas tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsam la tshe 'gugs bya: de nas bum dbang ni:
hrī: rin chen dbang gi bum pa ru: bde gshegs tshe yi lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan lus la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku thob shog:
rtsa sngags mthar
kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ:
phreng ba gtad la:
hrī: gang zhig rab tu bzlas pa na: dngos grub 'dod pa rdzogs pa'i thabs: gsung dbyangs sngags kyis dbang bskur bas: ngag la nus pa mchog thob shog:
rtsa sngags mthar
wā ka a bhi ṣīñca ā:
rdo rje gtad la:
hrī: rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen brtse'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru rnam par dag: rnam dag bde chen thugs kyi dbang: bu khyod yid la rab rdzogs shog:
rtsa sngags mthar
tsit+ta a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐:
tshe ril gtad la:
hrī: snying po ye shes lnga rdzogs pa'i: rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i yon tan dpal: 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i gter: bu khyod la ni yongs rdzogs shog:
rtsa sngags mthar
gu ṇa a bhi ṣīñca trāṃ:
tshe chang gtad la:
hrī: rgyal kun thugs rje ma 'gags pa'i: phrin las 'bad med chu rgyun bzhin: mi zad dngos grub gter chen po: skal ldan khyod kyis thob par shog:
rtsa sngags mthar
karma a bhi ṣīñca ā:
slar yang tshe 'brang spyi bor bkod:

hrī: zla gam dbang gi gzhal yas 'dir: ma chags thabs kyi rol pa che: bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: ma 'dres gsal rdzogs chen por bzhugs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs: lus kyi nad gdon kun dag nas: rdo rje'i sku ru grub par shog: gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs: ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: rdo rje'i gsung du grub par shog: thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs: sems rtog nyon mongs kun dag nas: rdo rje'i thugs su grub par shog: rang bzhin rnam dag sku gsung thugs: mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo nyid: glo bur sgrib las rab grol nas: zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku thob shog:
rtsa sngags mthar
kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la a bhi ṣīñca ā:
mda' dar spyi bor bsnol mar bzhag:

oṃ: rdo rje'i sku ste skye 'chi med: 'gyur med sku yis rgyas btab bo: ā: rdo rje'i gsung ste 'gag pa med: 'gag med gsung gis rgyas btab bo: hūm̐: rdo rje'i thugs te 'khrul pa med: 'pho med thugs kyis rgyas btab bo: sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: phyag rgya bzhi yis rab tu btab: gang gis mi tshugs mi shigs pa'i: yang dag rdo rje'i sku thob shog: badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: dharma rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: dz+nyā na rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐:

de nas bkra shis rgya cher brjod: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab par bya'o: sa ma ya: slob dpon chen po pad+mas phyi rabs las can gyi don du bkod pa'o: skal ldan rnams dang 'di 'phrad shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gu h+ya:
1$0000250ྈ las sbyor 'chi bslu'i man ngag 'chi bdag bdud 'joms bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈ rta mgrin dbang gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo:

rang nyid lo keg gi thog tu phyin pa'am: gnam lo gang rung gi lo mjug rnams su rnal 'byor pa dus min gyi 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs 'di la brtson par bya'o: rang gi lus la drud pa'i ngar zan la dur khrod gsum gyi sa sna cung zad bsres te ngar glud gcig dang: chang bu'am ril bu lo grangs sam brgya rtsa brgyad bya: skabs su nam mkha': mda' 'phang: dar zab: 'bru sman: rin chen sna tshogs: zas sna sogs yas glud ci 'dzom bsham kyang legs:
oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṝ wa hūm̐ phaṭa:
ces rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal la gnas pas glud gtor/
raṃ yaṃ khaṃ
dang
oṃ āḥhūm̐
lan gsum re brjod pas byin gyis brlab:

na mo: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bka' bden pa dang: bslu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum dang chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bka' bden pa dang: rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po'i stobs kyis bdag gi tshe dang srog gi glud gtor 'di dag: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang: lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad dang: byis pa'i gdon chen po bco lnga dang: 'phrog ma chen mo bu lnga brgya'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba dang: bgegs kyi rgyal po chen po la sogs te bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dang: mdor na bdag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe srog la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po ma rungs pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi spyod yul du 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa'i longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter chen po rtag pa rgyun du 'byung zhing tshims par gyur cig: tshims nas kyang sngon gyi lan chags ngan pa thams cad yongs su byang bar gyur cig: 'phral gyi rkyen ngan bar du gcod pa'i phyogs ma lus pa thams cad myur du zhi bar gyur cig: nad dang gnod pa than dang ltas ngan byad kha phur kha la sogs te mdor na mi mthun pa dang bkra mi shis pa'i phyogs su gyur pa thams cad myur du zhi bar gyur cig: bdag 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las yongs su thar bar gyur cig:

gdon dang bgegs kyi tshogs de dag kyang 'dod yon gyi sbyin pa mi zad pa'i gter gyis rtag tu tshim par gyur cig: 'dod yon gyi sbyin pa thob pa de srid du dam pa'i chos yang dag pa'i sbyin pa tshul bzhin du thob par gyur cig: chos yang dag pa'i sbyin pa thob pa de srid du byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag pa rgyud la skye bar gyur cig: byang chub kyi sems rin po che rgyud la skye ba de srid du byang chub kyi sems de las phyir mi ldog nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas chos kyi sku thob par gyur cig:
ces brjod la
saṃ bha ra
'i sngags re dang bstun chang bu'am ril bu bdun re bsngo: slar yang bden pa'i stobs chen po de bzhin du brjod: thams cad rdzogs pa dang: glud gtor kha phyir bstan la:

hūm̐: nga ni 'bar ba dbang gi sku: snang srid ma lus nga yi dbang: 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: bdag gi bka' las 'da' mi 'tshal: phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi: gtsang ma'i lha yi sde tshogs dang: de dag 'khor gyi gdon chen po: ming dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs bdag: lha yi gdon dang klu yi gdon: lha min dri za mi 'am ci: gshin rje ma bdud gza' dang btsan: gnod sbyin lto 'phye rgyal po'i gdon: dam sri 'byung po the'u rang sogs: sna tshogs nad dang gdon gyi bdag: tshe dang srog dang dbang thang dang: las rnams kun la bar du gcod: mi mthun phyogs kun sbyor byed pa'i: ma rungs gdug pa can gyi tshogs: de dag 'khor bcas ma lus dang: khyad par 'chi bdag gshin rje dang: khram kha stong gi bdag mo sogs: khams gsum srog la dbang ba rnams: bshams pa'i glud gtor 'di longs la: gnod pa'i bsam ngan zhi ba dang: tshe yi bar chad bzlog par mdzod: glud chen nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter: nam yang 'dzad pa med pa 'di: lha 'dres bzhes la tshe bdud zlog: dus min 'chi ba myur du sol: dus la babs kyang bshol thob cig: rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i glud: rnal 'byor sha khrag drod dbugs dang: sems kyi glud du gyur pa 'di: 'byung ba lnga yi khams la btang: 'byung lnga'i khams la dbang sgyur zhing: 'byung lnga'i khams la rten bcas pa'i: snang srid lha 'dre 'khor dang bcas:
glud gtor 'di yis mgu byos la: phyin chad 'khor 'dir ma gnod cig:
chos sbyin spyi dang mthun par byas la:

khyed rnams 'dug pa'i gnas med kyis: dpag tshad rgyang grags tshun chad du: ma nye ma 'khor gzhan du dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'tshe gyur na: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba yis: rdo rje can yang 'jig byed na: zag bcas lus rnams smos ci dgos: mgo lus me 'bar snying yang gtub: sdug bsngal dpag med myong 'gyur bas: 'di ru ma 'dug phyir dengs shig:

drag sngags brjod: thun gyi char dbab: glud gtor lo bdud sogs yas lam gtsang ba'i phyogs su bskyal: srung 'khor bsgom: tshe 'gugs mang du bya: bkra shis brjod: des 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro: bdag 'dra slob dpon pad+ma yis: snyigs dus dus min 'chi ba'i dpung: 'joms byed man ngag zab mo 'di: skal ldan don phyir lag len bkod: lan gcig phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe: thugs kyi sras dang 'di 'phrad nas: 'gro don phrin las mthar rgyas shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: : ༈ 'di ni 'jam mgon rin po che dang rigs bdag bla ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs phyir du kha bskangs te spar gsar du bsgrubs pa yin pas dbang lung sogs la zhib ca bya dgos pa yod do// zhes si tu pad+ma dbang mchog rgyal po kho bos ched du gdams pa'o// //
